This cleansing oil emulsifies into a lightweight, milky texture when mixed with water, making it easy to apply and rinse away. It dissolves makeup — even waterproof mascara and eyeliner — without tugging or scrubbing. I also tested it after a peel-off mask, and it removed the residue effortlessly. After rinsing, my skin felt soft, refreshed, and thoroughly clean without any greasy film or dryness. It's simple, effective, and gentle enough for daily use while still powerful enough for heavy makeup. This cleansing oil has become a staple in my two-step cleansing system, leaving my skin soft and super clean every time.
